subject.title: fix(agents): bound base64 image input before decode in tool-image sanitizer

question: Should tool-image inputs above 10 MiB be unconditionally omitted before resize, or should the hard ceiling be raised while retaining the same early guard?
rationale: Source inspection proves the early bound is necessary, but repository contracts define only the 5 MiB output target and 25 MP processing ceiling, not a maximum compressed source-image size; selecting the permanent rejection ceiling therefore needs ownership of the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept 10 MiB ceiling
options.body: Keep the conservative threshold and accept that larger tool images degrade to text instead of being resized.

options.title: Raise the safe ceiling
options.body: Use measured heap proof to select a larger pre-decode threshold if legitimate large screenshots must remain resizable.

recommendation.title: Accept 10 MiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Keep the conservative threshold and accept that larger tool images degrade to text instead of being resized.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and has most recently maintained the sanitizer and its size policy.
